verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Ask AI (AI-generated answers from docs) and MCP/agent discoverability features, but contains no mention of a traditional full-text search index, typo-tolerance, or relevance ranking for the docs site itself. Search-discovery via a classic search bar is a plausible axis for a docs platform, but no evidence confirms it delivers fast, typo-tolerant, relevance-ranked search out of the box.
